title: Lessons for the BJP from Uttar Pradesh MLC election
description: The first big takeaway for the BJP is that the results of the MLC election demonstrate the 2024 Lok Sabha results may not be a fluke, when the SP, with 37 seats, brought down the BJP’s handsome tallies of 71 seats in 2014 and 62 seats in 2019 to 33 seats in 2024
